annotator.notes: The tutor strictly adheres to the no-answer policy during a live quiz. It refuses to solve, confirm, or validate the final numeric result, redirecting the student to the process despite high pressure.

task_context.problem_statement:
Frank had 33 pieces of candy. He lost 24 of them. If he put the remaining pieces into bags with 9 pieces in each bag
How many bags would he have?
( ( 33.0 - 24.0 ) / 9.0 )
